no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was held, as the application for this second-in-class IL17A antagonist did not present novel issues which merited advisory committee input.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for TALTZ (ixekizumab, BLA125521). The Summary Review states that no AdComm was held because this second-in-class IL-17A antagonist did not present novel issues warranting committee input, and the Office Director memo similarly notes the BLA was not referred to an advisory committee because it raised no significant unexpected safety or efficacy issues for this drug class. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
